justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/TroubleshootingGuide.java and found a 10-line utility class with a private constructor and exactly one public static method, createUrl(String). Repo usages in TypeToken, JsonReader, TypeAdapters, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory, ConstructorConstructor, and ReflectionHelper all call that same helper, indicating a single cohesive responsibility rather than a class that should be split into smaller abstractions.
